messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — finalizing webinar topic grid + microformats. Thinking 35–40m with a 10m Q&A. +1?
Jonah Kim: Sounds good. Want to prioritize 'practical inference economics' as the headline.
Priya Desai: +1 on headline. Propose two demo lanes: hosted API (low-friction) and private deploy (SLA/cost story).
Carlos M.: Agree. Also recommend a 3-min lightning demo slot for an ops checklist (autoscale + fallback). Keeps momentum. :zap:
Maya Patel: Love the lightning idea. We also need to decide on audience segments to route attendees to follow-ups (startup vs enterprise).
Priya Desai: For routing: simple Typeform that captures company size + usage intent. Tag responses and push to SFDC. Link placeholder: https://form.example/seg
Jonah Kim: Run-of-show draft (super-tight):
```
00:00 Host intro + TLDR (3m)
03:00 Benchmark narrative: latency vs cost tradeoffs (7m)
10:00 Demo lane A: Hosted API quickstart (8m)
18:00 Demo lane B: Dedicated/Private deploy cost & rollout (8m)
26:00 Lightning ops demo (autoscale/fallback) (3m)
29:00 Customer vignette + top takeaways (6m)
35:00 Live Q&A + routing CTA (10m)
```
Maya Patel: That pacing helps. Can we make the benchmark narrative visual-first (2 slides) + 1 real query example?
Carlos M.: Yep — I'll prepare a latency vs cost chart and a short query replay (show token timing).
Priya Desai: Speakers — confirmed: Jonah (benchmarks), Carlos (demos), Maya (host), plus guest SME for enterprise use case. Need short bios + 1-sentence talk blurbs by EOD Tuesday.
Jonah Kim: I'll send mine. Also want to include a tiny live failover demo: force model variant fallback. Short and dramatic. :grimacing:
Maya Patel: Backup plan: record a 90s clip of each demo and upload to S3 in case live demo fails. Put link in slide notes.
StudioBot: Reminder: rehearsal slot auto-booked for Wed 09:00 PT — calendar invites sent.
Carlos M.: Rehearsal checklist: mic test, video feed, demo creds, network VPN off (simulate customer infra), and failover clip ready. I'll draft a checklist doc.
Priya Desai: Messaging: headline, 2 bullets on what attendees will learn, CTA to segmented Typeform. I'll iterate and share in #marketing-drafts.
Maya Patel: Final callouts — run the lightning demo on stage machine (no VPN), have an engineer on standby, and enable chat triage for product questions.
Jonah Kim: Also want a short Twitter thread plan for launch: benchmark hook + gif of demo, link to recording. I'll draft.
Maya Patel: Great. Action items: bios + blurbs (all, EOD Tue), checklist (Carlos), Typeform + routing rules (Priya), rehearsal prep (everyone). Will follow up with a consolidated run-book. :calendar:
